Name: Nerissa Vale - The Salvagewright
Author: AleksSmash2020
Description:
The Beach has a memory. Nerissa knows how to read it.

Nerissa Vale is a new non-romance NPC for Stardew Valley. She is a practical salvagewright who keeps a small workbench near the Beach and gives a few common by-products a fair, limited use. The mod is meant to make a familiar place feel more lived-in without replacing the vanilla recycling loop or adding an unrestricted money printer.

[b]What the player does[/b]

Meet Nerissa, learn her schedule and build friendship through daily conversation, gifts and events. At the appropriate progression points, use Tide-Wrapped Bait to turn Broken Glasses and Fiber into a small bait bundle, visit Nerissa's Beach workbench while she is nearby, and use limited daily offers for Bait or Wild Bait with gold and shore salvage. A later friendship reward, The Careful Chisel, opens a restrained Deluxe Bait option paid with a Geode.

[b]Character and progression[/b]

Nerissa has an original portrait set, overworld sprites, gift preferences, weather dialogue and a short friendship story about finding a place in Pelican Town. Five friendship events provide localized letters and staged rewards. The shop remains deliberately bounded by daily stock and salvage costs, so the character adds a routine rather than replacing fishing, recycling or the rest of the economy.

[b]Installation and compatibility[/b]

Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then place `[CP] Nerissa Vale - The Salvagewright` in the Stardew Valley `Mods` folder and launch through SMAPI. This is a Content Patcher pack with no DLL, native plugin, XNB replacement or third-party framework. A Beach overhaul that edits the same workshop tile may need a compatibility patch. Version 0.1.2 also fixes the shipped `default.json` and `ru.json` localization maps so SMAPI can read their flat key-to-string format; gameplay and assets are unchanged.

[b]Credits and disclosure[/b]

Nerissa Vale, the writing, configuration and visual assets in this package are original to this release. Created with AI assistance and tagged AI-Generated Content.
